header.allocation_proof: driver-local proof of the reserved H200, mirroring the instrument's with a memory floor: the instrument's proof requires exactly 128 GiB, which one frame's 131 GiB compile footprint does not fit

artifact_revisions.base_materialisation: git archive with the current row-persistence instrument overlaid
artifact_revisions.base_selection: first parent of the merge that landed the unit-aware wall consumers

header.comparator_self_check: identity set for comparator self-check carries 0 rows; a comparison over no rows cannot read as within drift
header.execution_route: one_compiled_program_per_frame, both strict-exit passes on the same program: the stacked vmap program the committed artifact was measured with is refused by this revision's accelerated history program, whose argument layout converts the vmapped target current with numpy
header.process_isolation: one re-executed child per frame, each started as a fresh `python <this driver> --frame-index <i>` that builds only its own member through strict_exit_incidence.build_diiid_member, with each frame's receipt written by its own child and a fresh process for the next: five frames in one process held 131 GiB resident after the first frame, and process exit is what returns it
header.re_exec_not_fork: children are re-executed rather than forked: a fork taken after a CUDA context is up deadlocks silently, so no process here forks
header.route_qualification: a difference measured on the per-frame route against an artifact measured on the stacked vmap route is device- and route-qualified

historical_control.qualification: The measurement driver and paired solve instrument are fixed; nova and supporting profile builders come from the historical revision. Equal seed, current and options hashes do not prove equality of every operator leaf. One control frame cannot attribute the other four frames.
historical_control.verdict: historical runtime restores frame 44 artifact residuals with the same measurement driver
